description: Fast read-only CMO feed list for ONE workspace (the user's current one unless workspace_id is given), with status counts and available actions. Use for pending review/feed/status questions.

limit.description: Maximum feed items to return, capped by the API.

status.description: Feed status to return. Defaults to pending.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Omit for the user's CURRENT workspace — other workspaces are NOT included. To reach another one, get its id from autowhisper_status.

name: autowhisper_feed
title: AutoWhisper CMO feed
